RA_anchor_policy: 2025 CSV uses original long-table age; calculator uses supplied age or date-derived exact age unless RA_anchor supplied.
interpretation: Conventional age-scale representation of M0, not an identified latent biological age. Coefficient sets units; not fitted to aging rate or health outcomes.
training_selection: one baseline per train Oneid; valid M0-7; 20 <= exact_age < 40; pooled sexes
